title: village-style roasted norwegian lamb wrap
description: roasted norwegian lamb shanks wrapped in corn husks with a hint of smoked paprika. inspired by traditional norwegian cuisine.
instructions: in a large Dutch oven, heat the olive oil over medium-high heat.
brown the lamb shanks on all sides, about 5 minutes per side. remove the lamb from the pot and set it aside.
add the onion to the pot and cook until it's translucent, about 5 minutes.
add the garlic, caraway seeds, smoked paprika, salt, and black pepper to the pot. cook for 1 minute.
add the browned lamb shanks back to the pot, then add the lemon juice and enough water to cover the lamb.
cover the pot and transfer it to the preheated oven.
bake for 2.5 hours, or until the lamb is tender and falling off the bone.
while the lamb is cooking, prepare the corn husks by soaking them in water for 30 minutes.
remove the lamb from the oven and let it rest for 10 minutes before serving.
wrap each portion of lamb in a corn husk, garnished with parsley and served warm.
